description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between evaluation context length and perplexity (PPL) for three different values of the compression parameter γ (0.25, 0.5, and 0.75) in the FreqKV method. The x-axis, labeled “Evaluation Context Length,” is on a linear scale ranging from 2K to 64K tokens, with tick marks at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis, labeled “PPL,” is also linear, spanning from 7.7 to 8.1, with major gridlines at 0.1 intervals. The blue line (γ=0.25) starts at approximately PPL=8.15 at 2K, drops sharply to ~7.82 at 4K, then gradually declines to ~7.78 at 64K. The orange line (γ=0.5) begins at ~8.14 at 2K, falls to ~7.75 at 8K, and stabilizes near 7.73 by 64K. The green line (γ=0.75) starts at ~8.15 at 2K, drops to ~7.85 at 4K, then declines more gradually to ~7.72 at 64K. All three lines show a steep initial drop in PPL as context length increases from 2K to 4K or 8K, followed by a much slower decline or plateau at longer context lengths, with γ=0.75 consistently achieving the lowest PPL across all context lengths beyond 4K.
